messages:
anna-sec: FYI — pen test flagged an issue where temporary/assumed-role creds could enumerate KMS aliases via our management plane. Customer (SOC2) escalated and wants a retest + audit evidence. See support ticket #CS-4821.
rohit-pen: repro steps I used in lab: assumed role, called KMS ListAliases and got full alias list. PoC command: 
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::000000000000:role/redwood-temp --role-session-name poc
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
aws kms list-aliases --region us-west-2
```
response included customer-managed alias names.
lee-sre: cc @michael-eng @natalie-sec. Need CloudTrail events for those calls + internal audit logs (auditd/audit-event-store) covering the time window. Also what retention policy are we claiming in the compliance pack? IIRC raw CloudTrail kept 90 days only. :thinking_face: 
sara-devex: can we get a minimal, repeatable repro in a dedicated test tenant? Don't want pen testing in prod. also request a JSON of the response for evidence.
michael-eng: I'll look at IAM/KMS policies that gate ListAliases. Quick check — some old role-policy allowed kms:* on resource arn:aws:kms:*:*:key/* which would let listing. I can push a staged policy tightening to only allow kms:ListAliases for aliases in the same account and add Condition SourceAccount.
natalie-sec: remediation checklist: 1) show policy diff + PR, 2) provide CloudTrail event IDs proving PoC, 3) HSM attestation if keys are backed by HSM, 4) show that we rotate roles with shorter session durations, 5) run an internal retest. Compliance needs audit trail screenshots or exported CSV.
support-bot: [ticket CS-4821] updated: requested evidence artifacts from eng-security. Assigned to michael-eng. ETA 48h.
rohit-pen: after michael's patch on staging i ran the same PoC against staging endpoint and got "AccessDenied" for ListAliases using assumed-role creds. Still able to list when using the legacy-service-role (long-lived) — seems that role still has broad kms permissions.
michael-eng: noted. I'll open a follow-up PR to remove kms:* from legacy-service-role and add resource restrictions. pushing to staging now. PR: #3124 (policy diff attached to ticket).
lee-sre: retrieving CloudTrail events for the original timestamps. Query I used: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=ListAliases --start-time 2026-02-10T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-02-11T00:00:00Z --region us-west-2
```
I exported matching events to s3://redwood-audit/evidence/CS-4821/ as compressed json.
anna-sec: typo — anna-sec :) Can you paste the event IDs here and a redacted snippet (no keys) so compliance can review?
lee-sre: EventIDs: evt-0a1b2c3d, evt-4e5f6g7h. Pasted redacted event snippets to the ticket. Also included the assumed-role ARN used in the calls.
natalie-sec: HSM note — for keys in customer tenant using HSM (Y/N)? If Y, need HSM module logs and attestation PDF. If keys are software-backed, we still need key policy updates. Please indicate per-key metadata.
michael-eng: only 3 keys in scope are HSM-backed. I've requested HSM attestation from infra team; ETA 24h. For the rest, PR #3124 restricts kms:ListAliases to specific key ARNs and adds Condition: {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceAccount": "123456789012"}}.
sara-devex: pen test team — can you retest with the legacy-service-role after michael's follow-up change? Also let's get a benign test harness so we can automate regression checks.
rohit-pen: retest done (staging): legacy-role still allowed listing until michael's second patch merged. after merge I retried and could not enumerate aliases. Retest logs uploaded to ticket.
anna-sec: thanks. one ask from compliance: they want a signed statement that the fix is deployed to prod and dates when CloudTrail/ audit exports were saved (for the incident window).
michael-eng: deploying policy change to prod in next deploy window (2h). Will attach prod deploy hash and updated policy diff to CS-4821.
natalie-sec: severity updated from high->medium->low after verification steps. closing severity once compliance confirms receipt of HSM attestation + CloudTrail export. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: [ticket CS-4821] customer notified of remediation and asked if they want an on-record retest.
anna-sec: great work team. please keep all artifacts in the ticket (policies, CloudTrail export, HSM attestation, retest logs). will loop in legal if customer requests an audit statement. :eyes:
